name: Domain / DNS Forensics

howTested: Executed Resolve-DnsName across Google DNS (8.8.8.8), Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), DuckDNS (ns1.duckdns.org), and local resolver
result: chillerstream.duckdns.org maps exclusively to 76.76.21.21 with TTL 60. Stale IP 49.37.109.122 is completely flushed; zero unexpected CNAME or AAAA records exist.

name: TLS / HTTPS Security
tested: TLS 1.3 handshake, certificate validity, CN match, and port 80 redirect
howTested: Connected via TLS socket directly to 76.76.21.21 with SNI chillerstream.duckdns.org, inspected peer certificate and HTTP port 80 permanent redirect
result: Certificate issued by Let's Encrypt (CN: chillerstream.duckdns.org), valid until Dec 25 12:01:30 2026 GMT. Port 80 returns 308 Permanent Redirect to https://chillerstream.duckdns.org/. Zero mixed content.

name: Vercel Domain Configuration
